reports.headline: Howling Where No Dogs Are Kept
reports.body: Every night this week, something has howled out in the grazing land {dir} of the village {dist}. {name} keeps no dogs, and neither does anyone else out that way. In the morning the {animal} were found pressed into one corner of the field, and the gate had been chewed through.

reports.headline: Graves Dug Up Along the Pasture Wall
reports.body: The old graves by the wall of the grazing land {dir} of here {dist} have been dug open, not by a spade: by claws. {name} heard panting in the dark and saw, for a moment, what looked like dogs without any skin on them. Nobody has gone back.

reports.headline: A Pack Seen at Dusk
reports.body: {name} swears a pack of dogs crossed the road near the grazing land {dir} of the village {dist} at dusk, red as meat and silent, and that none of them had eyes. The {animal} there will not settle at night.
